sidecar.description: The .jrsctl.json written next to the archive.

jobs.description: The sidecar's jobs block (issue #309, ADR-0059): whether the configured server's report jobs were recorded (--jobs), how many, from where, or why not.

origin.description: Recorded from the archive by hand, not written by a jrsctl export.

fullServer.description: The root folder with users, roles and report jobs: a js-export --everything archive.

keystoreFingerprint.description: Present when --source-keystore named the exporting server's .jrsks.

keyAlias.description: Present when --key-alias was given or index.xml names the Legacy key.
